subject: ENGLISH
title: Choose an Ending · M01 D03
objective: Choose a logical story ending supported by earlier events.
introduction: A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: The last part of a story or word.
A tale with characters and events.
A person or animal in a story.

activities.instruction: Study the idea and listen to the narration.

activities.instruction: Explore each example, then read the examples.

examples: A watered plant stands upright later.
A returned book goes back on its shelf.
A repaired wheel lets the cart move.

items.prompt: Which statement best matches “Choose an Ending”?

options.text: A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown.

items.explanation: The correct response is “A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown.” because it matches what we learned: A logical ending follows from the characters, problem, and events already shown.
